summary: First session: picked up and placed a block.
detail: Observed the island, walked to Block_12, picked it up and placed it nearby. Created semantic notes.

summary: Stacked Block_7 on Block_12 after learning placement height rules.
detail: Retried placing with higher y values; blocks settled on the ground. Built a two-block tower near the start.

summary: Tested throwing; one block was thrown off the island and lost.
detail: Moved Block_11 to the tower, took it back and threw it. First throw collided with the tower; second, at speed 15 westward, made it vanish from the world.

summary: Extended the tower to three blocks with Block_1.
detail: Fetched Block_1 from the hill, placed it above the tower from a step away; it settled on top of Block_7.

summary: Added a fourth block (Block_10) to the tower.
detail: Walking across the tower blocked me; routed around via waypoints, carried Block_10 over and placed it on top.

summary: Verified the four-block tower is intact at dusk.
detail: Observation showed Blocks 12, 7, 1, 10 stacked cleanly at 1.0 spacing near the start area; day turned to twilight.

summary: Walked to the far corner, picked up the Ring and tried pressing a button on it.
detail: Went around the Spire to reach the Ring; pickup worked, press found nothing. Plan: carry the ring to the tower.

summary: Carried the Ring back and placed it above the tower; briefly got stuck in a dip at night.
detail: Route along the west side dropped me below ground level; a move inland freed me. Ring placed on top of the four-block tower.

summary: Confirmed the finished tower: four blocks topped by the Ring.
detail: Observation at night showed the Ring resting on Block_10; the build is complete.
Rewrote SEMANTIC_MEMORY by topic: world layout, place/stack rules, throw, movement, press. Tower with Ring remains near start.

summary: Threw the Rock toward the tower; it fell short and left an ImpactBlock debris entity.
detail: Picked up the Rock from Hill_1 and threw it at the tower from ~15 units away. It landed about 5 units shy, and an ImpactBlock_1 appeared at the landing point.

summary: Second Rock throw landed next to the tower.
detail: Retrieved the Rock and threw it from ~5 units at moderate speed; it landed beside the tower without toppling it.

summary: Threw Block_2 at the tower; it fell just short and the tower stayed up.
detail: Fetched Block_2 and threw it horizontally from 8 units away; it landed near the base. Tower unscathed.
